mapper.select: SELECT R.RECRUITMENT_NO AS recruitmentNo, R.RECRUITMENT_TITLE AS recruitmentTitle, R.JOB_CODE AS jobCode, R.RECRUITMENT_STARTDATE AS startDate, R.RECRUITMENT_FINISH_DATE AS finishDate, R.RECRUITMENT_SALARY AS salary, R.CITY_CODE AS cityCode, R.DISTRICT_CODE AS districtCode, R.REC_CONTENT AS recContent, COUNT(A.APPLICANT_ID) AS applicantCount FROM RECRUITMENT_NOTICE R LEFT JOIN APPLICANT A ON R.RECRUITMENT_NO = A.RECRUITMENT_NO WHERE R.USER_ID = #{userId} GROUP BY R.RECRUITMENT_NO, R.RECRUITMENT_TITLE, R.JOB_CODE, R.RECRUITMENT_STARTDATE, R.RECRUITMENT_FINISH_DATE, R.RECRUITMENT_SALARY, R.CITY_CODE, R.DISTRICT_CODE, R.REC_CONTENT ORDER BY R.RECRUITMENT_STARTDATE DESC
SELECT USER_ID , RECRUITMENT_TITLE , JOB_CODE , RECRUITMENT_IMG , RECRUITMENT_SALARY FROM RECRUITMENT_NOTICE ORDER BY RECRUITMENT_SALARY DESC
SELECT RECRUITMENT_NO, USER_ID, RECRUITMENT_SALARY, RECRUITMENT_FINISH_DATE FROM RECRUITMENT_NOTICE ORDER BY RECRUITMENT_STARTDATE DESC;

SELECT -- RECRUITMENT_NOTICE rn.RECRUITMENT_NO AS RENO_RECRUITMENT_NO, rn.USER_ID AS RENO_USER_ID, rn.RECRUITMENT_TITLE AS RENO_RECRUITMENT_TITLE, rn.JOB_CODE AS RENO_JOB_CODE, rn.YEAR_CODE AS RENO_YEAR_CODE, rn.REC_CONTENT AS RENO_REC_CONTENT, rn.PREFERENTIAL AS RENO_PREFERENTIAL, rn.CITY_CODE AS RENO_CITY_CODE, rn.DISTRICT_CODE AS RENO_DISTRICT_CODE, rn.REC_POSITION_NUMBER AS RENO_REC_POSITION_NUMBER, rn.RECRUITMENT_CHARGER_TEL AS RENO_RECRUITMENT_CHARGER_TEL, rn.RECRUITMENT_SALARY AS RENO_RECRUITMENT_SALARY, rn.WELFARE AS RENO_WELFARE, rn.RECRUITMENT_DESK AS RENO_RECRUITMENT_DESK, rn.RECRUITMENT_IMG AS RENO_RECRUITMENT_IMG, rn.RECRUITMENT_STARTDATE AS RENO_RECRUITMENT_STARTDATE, rn.RECRUITMENT_RECEIPT_START AS RENO_RECRUITMENT_RECEIPT_START, rn.RECRUITMENT_FINISH_DATE AS RENO_RECRUITMENT_FINISH_DATE, rn.RECRUITMENT_DEL_DATE AS RENO_RECRUITMENT_DEL_DATE,
-- COMPANY c.USER_ID AS COM_USER_ID, c.COM_NAME AS COM_NAME, c.COM_INFO AS COM_INFO, c.COM_NUM AS COM_NUM, c.COM_EMAIL AS COM_EMAIL, c.COM_URL AS COM_URL, c.COM_CREATE_YEAR AS COM_CREATE_YEAR, c.COM_MEM AS COM_MEM, c.COM_LOGO AS COM_LOGO, c.COM_PAYMENT AS COM_PAYMENT, c.INDUSTRY_TYPE AS INDUSTRY_TYPE,
-- RECRUITMENT_EDUCATION (1:1) re.RECRUITMENT_EDUCATION_CODE AS EDU_RECRUITMENT_EDUCATION_CODE, re.CODE_DETAIL_NO AS EDU_CODE_DETAIL_NO, re.RECRUITMENT_EDU_DEL_DATE AS EDU_RECRUITMENT_EDU_DEL_DATE,
-- RECRUITMENT_POSITION (1:N) rp.RECRUITMENT_POSITION_CODE AS REP_RECRUITMENT_POSITION_CODE, rp.CODE_DETAIL_NO AS REP_CODE_DETAIL_NO, rp.RECRUITMENT_POSITION_DEL_DATE AS REP_RECRUITMENT_POSITION_DEL_DATE,
-- RECRUITMENT_SKILL (1:N) rs.RECRUIT_SKILL_CODE AS RSK_RECRUIT_SKILL_CODE, rs.RECRUIT_SKILL_NAME AS RSK_RECRUIT_SKILL_NAME, rs.RECRUIT_SKILL_DEL_DATE AS RSK_RECRUIT_SKILL_DEL_DATE,
-- RECRUIT_PROCESS (1:N) rp2.RECRUIT_PROCESS_NO AS REPR_RECRUIT_PROCESS_NO, rp2.RECRUIT_PROCESS_STEP AS REPR_RECRUIT_PROCESS_STEP, rp2.RECRUIT_PROCESS_FINAL AS REPR_RECRUIT_PROCESS_FINAL, rp2.RECRUIT_PROCESS_TYPE AS REPR_RECRUIT_PROCESS_TYPE, rp2.RECRUIT_PROCESS_DEL_DATE AS REPR_RECRUIT_PROCESS_DEL_DATE
FROM RECRUITMENT_NOTICE rn JOIN COMPANY c ON rn.USER_ID = c.USER_ID LEFT JOIN RECRUITMENT_EDUCATION re ON rn.RECRUITMENT_NO = re.RECRUITMENT_NO LEFT JOIN RECRUITMENT_POSITION rp ON rn.RECRUITMENT_NO = rp.RECRUITMENT_NO LEFT JOIN RECRUITMENT_SKILL rs ON rn.RECRUITMENT_NO = rs.RECRUITMENT_NO LEFT JOIN RECRUIT_PROCESS rp2 ON rn.RECRUITMENT_NO = rp2.RECRUITMENT_NO WHERE rn.RECRUITMENT_NO = #{recruitmentNo}

SELECT RECRUITMENT_NO , USER_ID, JOB_CODE , YEAR_CODE, REC_CONTENT , PREFERENTIAL , CITY_CODE , DISTRICT_CODE , REC_POSITION_NUMBER , RECRUITMENT_CHARGER_TEL , RECRUITMENT_SALARY , WELFARE , RECRUITMENT_DESK , RECRUITMENT_IMG , RECRUITMENT_STARTDATE , RECRUITMENT_RECEIPT_START , RECRUITMENT_FINISH_DATE , RECRUITMENT_TITLE FROM RECRUITMENT_NOTICE
mapper.update: UPDATE RECRUITMENT_NOTICE SET RECRUITMENT_DEL_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE RECRUITMENT_NO = #{recruitmentNo}
